title: Chat thread
description: A chat with an AI assistant playing out: the question types into the composer and is sent up as a bubble, typing dots answer, then the reply streams in word by word in large display type; after a beat, *starred* words in the reply get an accent marker sweep. Up to three exchanges. For AI product demos, 'I asked…' hooks and support/assistant promos.

default: Can you turn my 40-page report into a one-page summary?
Done. I kept the *three key findings*, one line each, and ended on the *next steps*.
messages.description: The conversation, alternating: the user first, then the assistant, and so on. Wrap words of a reply in *stars* for the marker sweep.

assistant.description: The assistant's name, shown above its replies and in the composer's placeholder.

placeholder.description: Grey text in the empty composer (empty: 'Ask <assistant>…').
